observations: Black and red exercise bike with a digital console on the handlebars.
The brand name 'AMERICAN SPORT' is visible on the front of the flywheel housing in photo 0.
The bike has a padded seat, handlebars, and a front and rear stabilizer system.
The base is a standard commercial-style stand with four wheels.
A power cable is visible on the floor next to the bike.

claims.evidence: photo 0 shows a commercial-grade flywheel and stand.

claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The electronic console may be non-functional or have a dead battery.
risks.proof: A video showing the console powered on and displaying a workout timer.

risks.risk: The flywheel may be damaged or have excessive wear.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the flywheel and the underside of the flywheel housing.

risks.risk: The internal resistance mechanism (gears) may be worn or non-functional.
risks.proof: A video showing the resistance knob being turned and the resistance changing.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Video of the console powered on and cycling through menus.

response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
